title: Version 17.12.4
body_markdown:
*Released January 14th, 2025*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| Addressed an incompatibility between Live++ (a 3rd party C++ Hot Reload tool) and Visual Studio 2022. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/VS2022-debugger-doesnt-adjust-RIP-corre/10801166) |
| Addressed a hang in All-In-One Search (Ctrl+T, Ctrl+Q). | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Code-search-hangs-after-typing-a-few-cha/10774334) |
| Visual Studio Debugger can't display values in 'Locals' window. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Visual-Studio-Debugger-cant-display-val/10797594) |
| Fixed a bug causing VS to immediately crash and close when opening the NuGet Package Manager if the right-side details pane was sized to be very small. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Visual-Studio-Crashes-when-you-click-on-/10789201) |
| Fixed an issue where hovering over a docker file could hang VS. |  |
| Fixed an issue with incorrect initialization for certain structs with zero-sized members. |  |
| Fixed an issue for x86 targets where frame registers used during coroutines may not be reloaded correctly. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Coroutine-code-generation-bug-in-x86-rel/10779602) |
| VS now includes MAUI 8.0.100 (SR10); MAUI 9.0.14 (SR1.4) |  |
| Fixed syntax color flicker while scrolling via [https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/pull/75796||](https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn/pull/75796%7C%7C) |  |

| Security advisories addressed | CVE |
| --- | --- |
| .NET and Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-21172**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-21172) |
| .NET, .NET Framework, and Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-21176**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-21176) |
| Visual Studio Remote Code Execution Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-21178**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-21178) |
| Carriage-return character in remote URL allows malicious repository to leak credentials | [**CVE-2024-50338**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-50338) |
| .NET Remote Code Execution Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-21171**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-21171) |
| (Linux only) .NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-21173**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-21173) |
| Visual Studio Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [**CVE-2025-21405**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2025-21405) |
